title: CAD tool settings (command-line flags and environment variables)
description: The tunables of the cad tools that a flag or an environment variable sets today, with their defaults, hard bounds (an error) and plausibility bands (x-plausible: a warning plausibility.<field>). x-cli names the flag and x-env the environment variable exactly as the code reads it; a field with neither is a constant in the code. The config loader and the Click helper read flag, env name and bounds from here. Cross-field rules stay with the loader: access min_step_mm at most step_mm, and form_check joint, radius and fidelity choices follow the process in use

step_mm.description: Initial sample spacing along each path

separation_margin_mm.description: SEPARATION_MARGIN_MM, a constant in the code

mesh_band_mm.description: Fast mode: how far beyond its clearing threshold a request's proved bound must lie

jobs.description: Concurrent jobs; the flag also takes auto, which the loader resolves from the CPUs and memory

job_rss_gib.description: Memory budgeted for each FreeCAD job, in GiB: the job count is bounded by the free memory over this. A constant in the code

size.description: Frame size WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels, each side 100 to 9999; motion.py render has its own default of 1280x720

raster_threads.description: 1 limits Chromium to one raster thread; any other value was silently ignored, so only 1 is valid

preflight.description: cad-flow preflight.py, constants in the code

sync_timeout_s.description: Resolve and install an environment from scratch

import_timeout_s.description: A cold first OCP load on a busy Mac has taken over 1100 s

startup_timeout_s.description: A background warm-up records itself as running within this
